scene_text.text: Waist-up candid phone snapshot of him caught mid-stride, walking briskly toward the camera on the upper walkway of a mall early in the morning, taken from chest height with the phone tipped slightly upward and the frame tilted about 3 degrees as if grabbed in a hurry. He is a little off-centre toward picture-right, one shoulder ahead of the other, his weight moving forward. His head turns to the lens a moment late, his eyes just finding the camera, with a quick half-smile, one corner of the mouth lifted and the lips barely parted, a fleeting look rather than a pose. A white non-woven tote bag swings from his right shoulder at picture-left, its flat strap cut off by the left edge of the frame; the bag and his free hand, with a round black smartwatch on the wrist, smear with motion blur as they swing. He wears an oversized, boxy cream cotton crew-neck t-shirt with short sleeves; across the chest is the print shown in the PRINT DESIGN image, copied exactly and kept sharp and flat: four centred lines of wide, round geometric sans-serif capital letters in a bright crimson red, reading I DON'T CARE / IF SHE GOT / RED FLAGS in bold, and I'M A BULL below them in a regular, thinner weight, filled solid red like the rest and not outlined. Behind him, seen from slightly below, there is only the mall's high white ceiling with rows of round warm lights and the top rail of a glass balustrade, all in a soft portrait-mode blur. The walkway is empty at this early hour: he is the only person anywhere in the frame. Uneven, slightly warm indoor light; fine phone grain. Vertical 2:3 frame.
